performance_review_requires: At least 20 observed market sessions; no edge conclusion from this minimum alone

experiments.hypothesis: A comparable EPS beat plus a verified increase in issuer revenue guidance can continue after a strong completed reaction session.
experiments.review_dependency: Prospective consensus and reviewed issuer evidence; unknown accounting basis cannot qualify

experiments.hypothesis: A liquid completed-session breakout confirmed by elevated daily volume can continue without a narrative or LLM score.
experiments.review_dependency: Calendar, complete regular-session history and current quote/news coverage

rules: Never reset account history or conceal failed trials
No hot-streak sizing or parameter tuning during the registered evaluation
Report exposure, drawdown, costs, gaps and source failures alongside returns
Compare same-date cash and broad-market benchmarks before claiming improvement
Shadow plans are neither simulated fills nor broker P&L
cost_stress_status: Registered evaluation assumptions; not automatically deducted from Alpaca equity
